arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} At {c_number}[Affix_Value_2]{/c} stacks of {c_important}Stoicism{/c}, you explode in a feral {c_important}Rampage{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds. While {c_important}Rampaging{/c}, you grow larger allowing your {c_important}Werebear{/c} Skills to deal {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. In addition, {c_important}Rampaging{/c} allows you to move {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} through enemies Knocking them Down.
